datasets.title: Chad - Settlement catchment areas
datasets.description: This dataset shows settlement-based catchment areas in Chad with information on total population disaggregated by sex and age and number of buildings.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/chad-settlement-catchment-areas]

lineage.description: Settlement catchment areas were generated by identifying population clusters from gridded population data (WorldPop, Kontur, Meta), assigning representative points to each cluster, and using Voronoi tessellation or similar spatial algorithms to delineate catchment boundaries. Population was disaggregated by sex and age from Meta datasets, and building counts were extracted from OpenStreetMap and Google building footprints to characterize settlement infrastructure.

sources.name: WorldPop
sources.description: Gridded population estimates for 2020 used to identify settlement clusters and disaggregate population by location

sources.name: Kontur
sources.description: Alternative population distribution dataset (2023) providing validation and comparison for settlement population estimates

sources.name: Meta
sources.description: High-resolution population data with demographic disaggregation by sex and age groups (2023)

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.description: Building footprint inventory providing structure counts within settlement catchment areas

sources.name: Google
sources.description: Machine-learning derived building footprints at 70% and 80% confidence thresholds for validation
